content: In NMT, the Transformer BIBREF0 is a sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) model which maps an input sequence to an output sequence through hierarchical multi-head attention mechanisms, yielding a dynamic, context-dependent strategy for propagating information within and across sentences. It contrasts with previous seq2seq models, which usually rely either on costly gated recurrent operations BIBREF15, BIBREF16 or static convolutions BIBREF17.
